guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice_diskio jumps from 0 to 9.6e9 after the alert, the largest anomaly in the digest by many orders of magnitude, alongside CPU up 6238% and memory up 209%, while no other service's metrics move materially (all |z| < 1). The worst traces go through frontendservice -> currencyservice -> productcatalogservice and never touch emailservice, and currencyservice latency is flat, so those slow traces do not contradict the emailservice finding but are not explained by it.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate and stop the process generating heavy disk I/O on emailservice (e.g. runaway writes or logging), restart the emailservice pod if needed, and add disk I/O limits. Also separately examine the frontend errors in the slow traces.
